method: Raw binary STL exact-coordinate weld only; actual mesh intersection crops, unrounded horizontal sections and even-odd nesting; exact -0.4 mm Shapely erosion on every positive component. No healing, island removal or thin-feature exemption.

thin_warning: Sloped-pane tangent slices, curved-shell/seat boundaries, and narrow LED seam lips can fall below a 0.8 mm erosion core. All observed failures remain recorded. Horizontal component erosion is not a global normal-wall thickness proof and connected masses can mask details, hence separate glass/arm/seat crops.
glass_translation: Rear and roof glass sheets are physical STL solids. Scene alpha / 3MF display alpha does not create geometric air and cannot make opaque filament transparent. Glazing crops are therefore tested as solid. True source openings and entrance are separately tested for zero occupied volume.
limitations: Photos/drawings support bounded visual approximation, not survey dimensions. These numerical samples do not validate complete wall thickness, structural strength, bridge spans, slicer extrusion widths, FFF support removal, accessibility or physical printing. Downward area is not automatic support area or filament consumption.
